description: This file defines the `FireworksAIConfig` class, which extends configuration capabilities for interacting with the Fireworks AI platform's chat completion API. It contains methods for parameter management, request transformation, response processing, and model fetching, tailored specifically for Fireworks AI's API integration. The class includes handling of custom parameters, tool support, and special behaviors such as transforming inline images and handling tool calls within messages.

classes.name: FireworksAIConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Fireworks's Chat Completions API interfacing, providing methods for parameter management, request transformation, response handling, and model querying specific to Fireworks AI platform.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the class by invoking the superclass's method.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines supported parameters for a given model, including Fireworks-specific options such as tools, tool_choice, and reasoning_effort based on model capabilities.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters into optional parameters, handling special cases for tool_choice, response_format, and max_completion_tokens.

methods.name: ChatCompletionImageObject _add_transform_inline_image_block( self, content: ChatCompletionImageObject, model: str, disable_add_transform_inline_image_block: Optional[bool], )
methods.description: Adds an inline transformation suffix to image URLs if applicable, enabling non-vision models to parse images.

methods.name: List[OpenAIChatCompletionToolParam] _transform_tools( self, tools: List[OpenAIChatCompletionToolParam] )
methods.description: Transforms a list of tools by removing 'strict' from function definitions.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] _transform_messages_helper( self, messages: List[AllMessageValues], model: str, litellm_params: dict )
methods.description: Processes message list to add inline image transformation and migrate file content to image URLs, filtering cache control.

methods.name: ProviderSpecificModelInfo get_provider_info(self, model: str)
methods.description: Identifies provider-specific features such as support for reasoning based on model name.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares request data by transforming model name, messages, and tools before calling superclass method for request sending.

methods.name: Message _handle_message_content_with_tool_calls( self, message: Message, tool_calls: Optional[List[ChatCompletionToolParam]], )
methods.description: Detects tool call info embedded in message content and converts it into proper tool call objects, per Fireworks AI's design.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Logs and processes the response, handling JSON parsing errors, attaching headers, and modifying choices as needed.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Resolves API base URL and API key from secrets or environment variables, for compatibility with OpenAI-like API formats.

methods.name: get_models(self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches available models from Fireworks API, adding a prefix to model names and handling error conditions.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API key from argument or secret storage, for authenticated API calls.
